data.body: **P2:** In the ADOT setup, `store()` runs in the application class loader while this `consume()` runs in the agent class loader, so their identity-based `KEY`s differ and `holder` is null. The property is cleared, but the application-side `AtomicReference` remains populated in the parent passed to `SpanProcessor.onStart`; forwarding that parent to an application-owned provider can therefore apply the durable sampling decision to an unrelated span. Avoid adding the context-key carrier on the cross-loader path (use only the one-shot property there), or use a carrier genuinely shared between loaders, and add a two-classloader regression that forwards the supplied parent.
